class.name: NetwEndpoint
class.brief_description: A server a player can join, listed in [member NetwConnection.endpoints].

method.name: probe
method.description: Asks the server for its [member status] and [member info] again. Does nothing once [member is_listed] is [code]false[/code].

members.member: The address passed to [method NetwConnection.add] or reported by its [LobbyDirectory].
The server name shown in a server browser.
What the server last advertised, or a default [NetwServerInfo] before it answers.
The sender's display name while [member is_invited], or [code]""[/code] when no name was supplied.
[code]true[/code] after [method NetwConnection.invite]. Cleared when joining this server reaches [constant NetwConnection.STATE_ONLINE] or the row is removed.
[code]false[/code] once the row is removed. Only [member peer_class] and [member address] keep their values after that.
The [MultiplayerPeer] class used to connect to this server.
The name of the [LobbyDirectory] that listed this row, or [code]""[/code] when the game added it with [method NetwConnection.add].

signal.name: changed
signal.description: Emitted when server information or the invitation changes.

constants.constant: No answer yet, or the server does not answer probes.
The server answered that it is full.
No answer arrived, or the probe failed.
Another game or another build of this game answered.
The transport does not work on this platform.
